name: H1.2 linker histone, cluster member
pathways: regulation of mRNA splicing, via spliceosome

function.text: H1-2 encodes histone H1.2. Annotated molecular activities include histone H3K27me3 reader activity and structural constituent of chromatin. It participates in regulation of mRNA splicing, via spliceosome and chromosome condensation.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.
